title: Payments
subtitle: Manual tenant payments (Mixx by Yas, Moov Money, cash, bank card).
newSubtitle: The payment is allocated to open invoices, oldest first. Any surplus becomes a credit.
referenceHint: Optional; unique for a given payment method.
allocationNoTenant: Choose a tenant to see its open invoices.
noOpenInvoice: No open invoice: the whole amount becomes a credit.
creditNotice: The surplus of {{amount}} will be kept as credit on the tenant's account.
overAllocated: The allocated total exceeds the payment amount.
duplicate: A payment with this method and reference already exists.

validation.amount: Enter a whole amount greater than 0.
validation.dateFuture: The payment date cannot be in the future.

sameUserHint: Double validation: this payment must be validated by a different user than the one who recorded it.
reverseWarning: The payment is never deleted: it is reversed and its invoices are reopened. The reason is kept.
